text:
esteban_sales: Heads-up — RegBank wants a short POC to validate Redwood against their on-prem Thales Luna HSM + CMK import. Ask: timeline, delta vs hosted pricing, rotation/rollback SLA, and what we can return on the security questionnaire. Can eng/security run this?

praveen_eng: I can run tech lead. Quick clarifying Qs: are they encrypting payloads with envelope encryption or expecting Redwood to use CMK for all DEKs? Also confirm target latency (p50/p95) and whether the HSM is reachable from internet or truly air-gapped.

esteban_sales: They prefer envelope encryption (we generate DEKs, then HSM wraps/un-wraps CMK ops). Target is ~150-250 qps peak, short prompts, ~25k tokens/day. They said on-prem only, but can spin up a relay VM in their VPC.

amanda_security: Security asks: 1) formal attestation artifact from Thales proving import (signed timestamped manifest), 2) documented rotation & rollback playbook, 3) retention policy for attestation (audit wants 7yrs). I'll draft questionnaire answers but need exact attestation fields.

ola_solutions: Minimal POC outline I propose: 
- Day 0-4: network & cert exchange (mTLS) + static IP whitelist
- Week 2: key import validation + perf runs (p50/p95)
- Week 3: rotation simulation + rollback test
Deliverable: perf report, attestation receipt, SOW draft. Who writes SOW line items?

maria_acct: Buyer asked "how much more for BYOK vs Redwood-managed?" They want monthly TCO. Include PS one-time and reserved capacity uplift.

billing_bot: Rough estimate (pending precise numbers): monthly KMS ops overhead ~+$0.025/1k KMS ops; BYOK PS integration one-time ~$15k (network, attestation handling, runbook); reserved capacity uplift estimate +18% for HSM roundtrip latency. Will produce formal quote.

siva_sre: Ops notes: if air-gapped — we need either a relay VM in customer VPC or an on-prem forwarder that speaks mTLS to Redwood. Relay must support mutual TLS and have NAT egress to our ingress IPs. We'll test with synthetic traffic and measure p50/p95. For rollback SLA 24h: achievable if we keep N=3 recent key versions and automatic KV cache fallback. Ops requires runbook sign-off and at least one dry-run pre-prod.

praveen_eng: Import format support: we accept PKCS#11 wrapped keys or Thales-wrapped RSA-OAEP blobs. If they need split-key (M of N), we support it but it's extra PS. Rotation: we implement rotation hooks to atomically switch prefixes and keep old prefixes for rollback window (configurable). Suggested default rollback retention: 72h with 2 previous versions retained; we can extend to 30d for compliance customers.

amanda_security: Add to checklist: encrypted transport for attestation files (SFTP + GPG) and storing only metadata in Redwood logs. Also require proof of HSM firmware version and FIPS module cert in attestation.

praveen_eng: Example export command we might request from customer (Thales sample):
```
	thales-cli --export --key cmk-789 --wrap-algo RSA-OAEP --recipient-cert redwood-ingest.pem --out cmk-789.wrap --manifest out.manifest.json
```
Include manifest fields: key-id, import-time, signer-cert-fingerprint, hsm-serial, firmware-version.

security_bot: We accept X.509 attestation chains from FIPS-certified HSM vendors. Required artifacts: signed manifest, signature cert chain, import timestamp, and operator identity. Redwood will persist only manifest + signature (no raw key material).

maria_acct: Legal wants a rotation SLA clause: "Redwood will support rollback of a rotation within 24 hours of detection if requested." Ops: can we commit?

siva_sre: We can operationally support a 24h rollback commitment provided: 
- customer agrees to keep previous key versions in HSM or allow us to fetch wrapped backups for rollback,
- runbook and cutover window agreed,
- dry-run completed. We'll require a 2-hour warmup period to rehydrate caches after rollback.

tom_policy: Policy team note: any contractual BYOK clauses that change key custody language need a short addendum. We prefer to avoid language that implies Redwood has access to raw CMK material. We'll draft sample contract language.

ola_solutions: I'll author the POC 1-pager. Security — please provide the exact attestation JSON schema (manifest field names) and Billing — a PS line-itemized draft (network, runbook, test automation).

praveen_eng: I'll create a short staging runbook and rotation test script after the call. Will also include a script to validate manifest signature:
```
openssl smime -verify -in out.manifest.json.sig -inform DER -certfile thales-chain.pem -CAfile thales-root.pem
```

amanda_security: I'll produce the questionnaire answers and flag items that "require customer confirmation" (HSM serial, firmware, split-key policy, escrow).

esteban_sales: I'll schedule the kickoff with RegBank for Tuesday 9am PT — will include SOW sketch and questionnaire. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

billing_bot: I'll drop a draft quote (PS lines, monthly delta, reserved uplift) in this thread by EOD Thursday.

ola_solutions: If anyone has previous Thales POC notes, paste links here. praveen — please attach runbook after you upload it.

praveen_eng: Will do. After kickoff I'll post the staging script + import manifest example.

amanda_security: Also: retention requirement for attestation artifacts = 7 years for auditors; mark that in SOW as compliance deliverable.

esteban_sales: Follow-up thread after kickoff will list action items and owners.
